about: Kept by hand by the projects desk from the journalist's re-grade against the evidence vault (phase-2/bbc-regrade.json, 27 October) and step 1's corrections (data b90449e). The editor's briefing proposed four points; after checking the captures, the BBC's reporting held up: two points were our own errors, now corrected in our data, and one is not a misquote. What is left is one optional suggestion. Nothing here is sent.

points.label: NCSC quote (question, not a correction)
points.held_reason: Not a misquote on our evidence: the BBC entry was published at 06:30:27 UTC, before the NCSC page changed at 07:30:02, and LBC quoted the same sentence from the NCSC on 21 October. An Internet Archive copy of the NCSC page from 06:43:47 UTC on 22 October would settle it (not yet readable from the desk). At most a question, never a correction.

not_asked.reason: Dropped: the BBC page states no disclosure date (it says details 'leaked online this week'). The error was ours, corrected in data b90449e.
